name: brand_kit_add_rule
description: Create or merge an owned kit hard-ban correction. The only enforced ban channel. Semantic matches require merge_rule_ids from brand_kit_list_rules. @see guides_get('brand-kit')

avoid_term.description: Term hard-banned in the negative prompt, max 200.

directive.description: Correction guidance, max 300. Highest-precedence <user_corrections> in the composer.

merge_rule_ids.description: All semantically equivalent rule ids from brand_kit_list_rules, returned order. Collapses them; same scope only.

source_creation_identifier.description: Provenance: the creation that motivated this rule. Must be viewable by you.

template_slug.description: Scope the rule to one template (slug from brand_kit_get). Omit for a global rule.
